scene: sea and surf -- a beach with rocks and a sandbar, Aljezur
standing_rulings: THE PURPOSE, and it comes before every other ruling. A reference implementation exists to PROVE and to IMPROVE the theory and mathematics in the skill. It is an instrument, not a product. A claim that cannot be implemented and measured is not yet knowledge; and an implementation built against a chapter is the sharpest review that chapter will ever get. Three consequences bind every wave: (1) A wave's deliverable is a VERDICT ON THE SKILL'S CLAIMS, not an artifact. 'It renders' is not a deliverable. 'This claim held to X%, this one did not, here is the separating measurement' is. (2) A finding that stays in the implementation's README is HALF-DELIVERED. Anything touching the theory must reach references/ -- in this skill or in a sibling -- or the next reader inherits the error with the authority of a citation. (3) The traffic runs BOTH WAYS and both directions are wins. A chapter corrected by a measurement is a win; an implementation corrected by a chapter is equally a win; and a claim that survives a serious attempt to break it is worth recording as survived, not passed over in silence.
Every wave produces visual evidence into gauntlet/sea/evidence/. Owner ruling, and the pool loop under-delivered on it.
The physics comes from physical effects, never from a constant chosen to make the picture right. Owner: 'Het moet komen door natuurkundige effecten.'
The geometry stays analytic -- a Dean profile and analytic solids. A sculpted mesh is unverifiable and ends the project's central claim.
The wave field arrives from OUTSIDE with a stated offshore spectrum, so shoaling and refraction are outputs and not inputs.
The pool does not disappear. Shared physics is imported, never copied; the pool's frames stay bit-identical and its suite stays green.
Measure in scene-linear, before the tone map. Never read a PNG for physics.
Do not calibrate against the photographs. They carry three camera failures and one unresolved eclipse; the target is the closed form.
A wave may conclude that a previous wave was wrong, and that is a good outcome. Budget for it: on the pool loop the highest-value waves added nothing and found something already there was broken.

Consult terrain-architect before inventing terrain. The bathymetry, the morphodynamic loop and the coastal IOPs are its material, and the two skills already share gamma ~ 0.78. Reconstructing any of it from memory is the failure this project exists to prevent.

Watch the radiation-stress factor of two: the longshore thrust is E_0/4 in DEEP-WATER quantities and E_b/2 in BREAKING-ZONE quantities, because c_g/c is 1/2 in deep water and 1 at breaking. Pairing the quarter with breaking-zone values is wrong by exactly two.

PRUNE, and do not chase 10/10. Owner ruling on the gauntlet-loop skill: it is token-inefficient, bogs down in continuous review, and does not cut unpromising paths fast enough. (1) Rounds are earned by open gaps, never scheduled -- the wave plan is void. (2) A gap that has survived two waves WITH ITS MECHANISM NAMED AND OUT OF SCOPE is PARKED with the reason recorded, not chased; the naming is the deliverable. (3) A separate critic is spent only on the VISUAL dimension, where the suite cannot reach and a builder's self-report is weakest. Elsewhere the builder's own discipline substitutes: fire every guard at a deliberately reintroduced bug, report what did not reproduce, overturn the predecessor where warranted.

BUILDERS PUSH THEIR OWN WORK. The container re-provisions without warning and restores the clone to an older commit; the remote is the only durable state. A builder that commits locally and waits for the orchestrator can lose an hour of work to a reset. Commit and push as soon as a coherent unit exists, and re-fetch before starting.

routes.bathymetry: terrain-architect references/12-glacial-coastal.md -- 'Surf-zone morphodynamics: bars, rips & the nearshore circulation' and 'Wave base & the submarine profile'. The breaker bar is an OUTPUT of the morphodynamic loop (waves -> radiation stress -> currents -> sediment flux -> Exner -> bed), not an authored ridge. Dean (1991) equilibrium ramp, depth proportional to distance^(2/3), is the far-field relaxation, not the whole profile.
routes.coastal IOPs: terrain-architect references/28-liquids.md -- 'The three constituents' and the Babin et al. 2003 concentration bridge, b_p(555)/SPM ~ 0.5 m2/g. CDOM darkens and does not scatter; sediment brightens; chlorophyll leaves the 550-570 nm window. Do not collapse them into one turbidity control.
routes.shared constant: gamma ~ 0.78 is already common to both skills -- 12-glacial-coastal names it as the same breaking index the renderer's break mask uses. Import it, do not restate it.

parked.item: section B, the second breaking line
parked.reason: Three waves. Wave 2 derived why (Gamma_eq above gamma_s on a shoaling bed; the trough is one dissipation e-folding wide, the reform needs two) and named the missing mechanism: the 2DH rip-feeder circulation. Wave 3 confirmed it is not geometry -- zero of 89 rows reform on a computed 2-D bay. Closing it means a 2DH solve terrain-architect chapter 12 declares out of scope. The mechanism is named and recorded; that is the deliverable. WAVE 5 FIRED ONE MORE THING AT IT AND IT SURVIVED: the derived UR_HALF makes the bar 33 per cent higher in relief and 15 m further seaward, and the min H/d in the trough moves 0.4556 -> 0.4571 against the 0.40 needed. A bigger bar is not the missing mechanism.

parked.item: section A, the backlit wave face reading green against grey-blue water
parked.reason: CLOSED AS UNREACHABLE RATHER THAN PARKED AS UNREACHED, and by a proof rather than a measurement. Wave 4 measured this scene's linear surface at 8.21 deg against the 41.48 deg = 90 - asin(1/n) a lengthwise in-water sightline needs, and named the route out: spend the wave skewness beach.py already computes on the free surface. Wave 5 took that route -- second-order Stokes driven by the file's own Ursell number, with the phase rotated from bound harmonic to bore by the breaking fraction -- and reached 15.78 deg, x1.95, with zero view rays leaving the far side of a crest at either surface. THE CEILING IS STOKES' 120 DEG CORNER (1880): at a stagnation crest q^2/2 + gz = 0 forces q ~ r^(1/2), a wedge flow of interior angle 2a has q ~ r^(pi/2a - 1), and matching gives 2a = 120 deg -- so the free surface leaves the crest at 30 deg for EVERY wave of permanent form, at any order, at any depth, deep-water Stokes and cnoidal and solitary alike. 30 < 41.48. Section A requires the wave to be within about 11 deg of overturning, which is the multivalued instant bar section F puts out of scope: A and F are ONE criterion at two moments. Section A's other half -- the falsification of a renderer that TINTS its water -- was discharged by wave 4's cuvette and stays discharged. Nothing further on the free surface will move this; closing it means changing the representation.

goal: TWO deliverables that prove each other. (1) The terrain-renderer skill reaches AUTHORITY on sea and open water -- the mathematics, the pseudocode and the inference rules present, every figure with a provenance mark, every claim either derived, cited, or marked open. (2) The reference implementation reaches HYPER-REALISM -- renders a viewer would have to wonder about. Neither alone is the goal: a chapter nobody implemented is untested, and a render nobody can derive is a picture. The render proves the chapter; the chapter explains the render.
hyper_realism_criteria: FRAME TO MATCH. A reference render must be shot from a viewpoint one of the owner's photographs was taken from, at the same framing, so the two can sit side by side. A render at a viewpoint no photograph shares is illustration, not proof.

NO PLACEHOLDER IN A HERO FRAME. A caption admitting a placeholder is the right discipline for a diagnostic and disqualifying for a reference. Every element in a hero frame is derived or the frame is not a reference yet.

THE TELL IS USUALLY NOT THE WATER. The pool bar's overriding rule carries: a single synthetic element anywhere in frame fails it, and it is usually the sand, the rock, the foam edge or the horizon rather than the water.
ONE CODE PATH. Every hero frame comes from the same code and the same constants as every other. A frame tuned for its own viewpoint proves nothing about the model.

contract: THE THEORY GOES IN THE SKILL AND THE CODE PROVES IT. Owner ruling. Every claim in a chapter must have a code path that demonstrates it -- offline OR through a rasterizer, and the choice is a decision, not a default. A claim with no implementation is a claim nobody has tested. Consequence, and it names the project's largest unproven region: the offline reference proves the PHYSICS, and nothing proves the APPROXIMATIONS. The chapter's real-time half -- the fullscreen-triangle pass, LOD and surface geometry, what to pre-cook, the LUT factorisation law, distance and filtering, transparency and pass ordering, the engine-native water architecture -- is written, cited and provenance-marked with ZERO lines of code behind it. A rasterizer reference proves what the offline path cannot, because approximation error is invisible to a path that does not approximate.
